zh: 客人来之前我把客厅收拾了一下。
en: I {tidied up|cleaned up|tidied|cleaned} the lounge before the guests arrived.

zh: 搬家之后我们终于安顿下来了。
en: We've finally {settled in|settled|settled down} after the move.

zh: 我们的新室友下周末搬进来。
en: Our new flatmate {moves in|is moving in|arrives} next weekend.

zh: 这个周末我得把车库整理一下。
en: I need to {sort out|clean out|clear out|tidy up|tidy|clean|organise|organize|clean up} the garage this weekend.

zh: 搬家的时候我们扔掉了很多旧东西。
en: We {threw out|threw away|chucked out|got rid of|chucked away|tossed out|dumped} a lot of old stuff when we moved.

zh: 你能把洗干净的碗碟收起来吗？
en: Can you {put away} the clean dishes, please?

zh: 上班前我把洗好的衣服晾出去了。
en: I {hung out|put out|hung up|hung} the washing before work.

zh: 我们出门前你把暖气关了吗？
en: Did you {turn off|switch off} the heater before we left?

zh: 你能把音乐调小点吗？宝宝睡着了。
en: Could you {turn down|lower} the music? The baby's asleep.

zh: 这里冻死了，你能把热泵调高一点吗？
en: It's freezing in here. Can you {turn up|crank up} the heat pump a bit?

zh: 我们的卫生纸又用完了。
en: We've {run out of} toilet paper again.

zh: 做完饭我把台面擦干净了。
en: I {wiped down|wiped|cleaned|wiped off|cleaned up|cleaned down|scrubbed} the bench after cooking.

zh: 昨晚我被锁在家门外了。
en: I got {locked out} of the house last night.

zh: 他们正在翻新我们街上那栋老别墅。
en: They're {doing up|renovating|fixing up|restoring} the old villa on our street.

zh: 该你倒垃圾了。
en: It's your turn to {take out|put out|empty} the rubbish.

zh: 周六我们在走廊里装了几个搁板。
en: We {put up|installed|fitted|hung|built|mounted} some shelves in the hallway on Saturday.

zh: 这张旧沙发快散架了。
en: This old couch is {falling apart|falling to bits|falling to pieces}.

zh: 厨房的水槽又堵了。
en: The kitchen sink is {blocked up|blocked|clogged|clogged up} again.

zh: 把窗户打开，给房间通通风。
en: Open the windows to {air out|air|ventilate|freshen up} the room.

zh: 因为下雨，我们待在家里看了部电影。
en: We {stayed in|stayed home|stayed at home} and watched a movie because of the rain.
